title: V11.21 Dispatch-Trace Line
description: Schema for ONE line of ~/.agent-metrics/dispatch-trace.jsonl. Appended by scripts/dispatch-trace-append once per orchestrator Phase 4 spawn (skill-level, NOT a Claude Code hook). Captures routing intent vs reality so V11.22 can calibrate META_MAP/COMPLEXITY_ROUTING from real dogfood data. Line size cap: 4096 bytes (override_reason truncated first when over). Rollback: V11_DISPATCH_TRACE=off.

recommended_agent.description: Agent the orchestrator's routing logic (scripts/agent-recommend / metadata.agent) recommended.

spawned_agent.description: Agent actually spawned. Diverges from recommended_agent on user override, agent unavailable, or DAAO escalation.

override_reason.description: Free-text rationale when spawned_agent != recommended_agent. Truncated with '…' suffix when the full line would exceed 4096 bytes.

model.description: Spawn model: sonnet | opus | haiku | inherit.

mode.description: Spawn mode: default | acceptEdits | bypassPermissions (autonomy-aware per orchestrate.md).

caller_kind.description: Was the spawning agent the main orchestrator session or a delegated subagent?

self_review_omitted.description: True when the spawned agent's prompt lacks the V11.21 self_review postamble (one of the ~100 agents phased to V11.22). Surfaces the known coverage gap without blocking dispatch.

batch_review_ids.description: OPTIONAL. Present when one reviewer spawn covers K review tasks (batch-claim mode) — the full set of task-id strings covered by this single dispatch. Absent means single-review dispatch (backward compatible with all pre-R6 callers).

event.description: OPTIONAL (W3-T12). Record shape marker, e.g. 'dispatch' (default, when any token-capture flag is supplied) or 'completion'. Absent entirely on pre-W3-T12-shaped lines (backward compatible).

tokens.description: OPTIONAL (W3-T12). Total tokens reported for this spawn (harness task-notification subagent_tokens). Never fabricated — absent when the harness didn't report it.

tool_uses.description: OPTIONAL (W3-T12). Tool-use count reported for this spawn. Never fabricated — absent when the harness didn't report it.

duration_ms.description: OPTIONAL (W3-T12). Wall-clock duration in ms reported for this spawn. Never fabricated — absent when the harness didn't report it.
